name: Autosomal Recessive Hyperinsulinism Due to SUR1 Deficiency

ethnicAssociations: Higher prevalence reported in populations with consanguinity

criteria.description: Persistent hypoglycemia with inappropriately elevated insulin levels during hypoglycemia
Identification of biallelic pathogenic variants in the ABCC8 gene encoding SUR1
Poor or absent response to diazoxide therapy
Imaging studies excluding focal lesions (e.g., 18F-DOPA PET scan showing diffuse uptake)

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Persistent hypoglycemia with elevated insulin plus biallelic ABCC8 mutations
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing is essential for definitive diagnosis and to guide treatment.
